scientific.integrity: The proof is analytic and uses only character orthogonality, an exhaustive collision classification for six unordered pair sums, and sharp quadratic optimizations. Finite enumeration is corroborative rather than evidentiary for the universal quantifier.
scientific.limitations: The theorem treats exactly three characters of a finite cyclic group and the fourth moment; it does not extend the five-case taxonomy to larger supports or non-even exponents.

title: Exact Lambda(4) constants for every three-character subset of a cyclic group
